name: South Carolina SCHSL State Cross Country Championships
headline: South Carolina SCHSL State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Mauldin won the 5A girls title by 50 points over Chapin, and Fort Mill’s Lauren Allen won the race in 18:27. Nation Ford won the 4A boys title as May River’s Jackson Wright won in 15:31. Walhalla swept the 3A boys team and individual titles behind Finn Powell (15:55), and Hanahan edged Christ Church by five points for the 3A girls title as Christ Church’s Charlotte Shew won in 18:31. Greer Middle College swept the 2A team titles.
